model_limitations.baseline: Bootstrap resamples training rows and is non-generative.
model_limitations.copula: Gaussian copula supports continuous-only tabular data with empirical marginals and linear latent dependence; it does not capture arbitrary nonlinear or tail dependence.
model_limitations.flow: Phase 3A flow supports continuous-only tabular features with no missing values.
model_limitations.gmm: Gaussian mixtures support continuous-only tabular data and can be sensitive to component count and covariance regularization.
model_limitations.vae: Supports continuous and binary tabular features with Gaussian/Bernoulli observation assumptions.
